description: Holds a gate high between two triggers, one jack raising it and the other dropping it

inputs.text: A rising edge here takes the gate output to 10V and leaves it there; an edge arriving while the gate is already high changes nothing. The threshold is 2V rising and 0.1V falling
A rising edge here returns the gate output to 0V; an edge arriving while the gate is already low changes nothing. The threshold is 2V rising and 0.1V falling

outputs.text: Carries 10V from the start trigger until the stop trigger arrives, and 0V the rest of the time; a freshly placed module starts at 0V

notes: the gate has no length of its own: with nothing patched to STOP it stays high for as long as the patch runs
the three lamps follow, from the top down, the voltage at START, the voltage at STOP, and whether the gate is high

inputs.0:
high above 2V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.1:
high above 2V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage does nothing here.
